name: lark-local-agent
description: A local Lark agent with independently runnable daemon and activity web modules.

scripts.check: bash -n scripts/deploy.sh && for file in packages/daemon/src/*.mjs packages/daemon/scripts/*.mjs packages/web/src/*.mjs packages/web/scripts/*.mjs packages/web/public/*.js packages/updater/src/*.mjs packages/updater/bin/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
